pages: He was dying when he found the grey stone. Everyone says so; he says so himself, and smiles. The rot was in his lungs and the physicians had sent him home to wait. He did not wait. He went to the places where the ground had turned and he breathed there, on purpose, every morning, and wrote down what it did to him. It stopped the dying. It did not give him back the living. He says that was the lesson: that living was the disease all along.
